summary: Segura Endpoint Privilege Manager: it removes standing local administrator rights on Windows and Linux and grants elevated rights by rule and temporarily.
value: Malware launched by a user does not get full control of the computer.
Needed programs and actions work by rule, without help-desk tickets.
Commands run with administrator rights are recorded.
simple: Removes standing local administrator rights on Windows and Linux computers: allowed programs and administrative actions receive elevated rights by rule and temporarily, and sudo commands on Linux are controlled by detailed policies. Records Windows sessions and sudo actions for audit; integrates with Active Directory and SIEM. Separate product, purchased in addition to Segura PAM Core; cloud, on premises or hybrid.
classification: The class is EPM; a separate product bought on top of PAM Core.
